sections.title: Field
sections.intro: The best photos are the ones taken in the field! I have been privileged to visit numerous locations to conduct ecological field research. I hope these photos can provide a glimpse into the perspective of plant ecologists, inspiring interest in empirical research.

sections.title: Photography
sections.intro: I started capturing what I see and feel through photography as a teenager. Over the years, there have been a few photos that consistently transport me back in time, allowing me to reconnect with the people and landscapes they depict.
